ptBR.notes: Pokémon Champions has no Brazilian Portuguese text (10 languages; Latin American Spanish is the closest). In Brazil, Pokémon species names are the English names, so species need no translation. No official machine-readable PT-BR move/ability/item names exist for Champions. Partial alternatives: (1) Pokémon GO official PT-BR strings (PokeMiners/pogo_assets 'Texts/Latest APK/JSON/i18n_brazilianportuguese.json', commit c2a686e): 419 move_name keys, 357 of them match Showdown move names by their English text (e.g. Flamethrower -> 'Lança-chamas', Earthquake -> 'Terremoto', Moonblast -> 'Explosão Lunar', Close Combat -> 'Corpo-a-corpo'), but many VGC moves are absent (Fake Out, Protect...), and GO has no abilities or held items. (2) PokeAPI has language 'pt-br' (id 13) but only 12 ability names and 0 move/item names (data/v2/csv/*.csv, commit 2bf639e). (3) Pokémon Winds and Waves (next mainline game) is reported to add Brazilian Portuguese, a possible future official source. Recommendation: keep Showdown English display names as canonical IDs and show the PT-BR UI text around them; optional PT-BR move glossary from Pokémon GO flagged as such.

nextRegulation.notes: As of 2026-10-27 no official announcement of the regulation after M-C was found. 'M-D' is only a community guess (Game8). Vice reports Mega Heatran is expected in a December update (unconfirmed). Events from 2026-12-02 onward (e.g. Las Vegas Regional, 4-6 Dec 2026) will use the next, still-unannounced regulation.

season2026.notes: 2026 season (Sept 2025-Aug 2026) started on Scarlet/Violet; Champions became the official title for online competitions after its release, and in-person from the Indianapolis Regional (May 29-31, 2026). Worlds 2026 (San Francisco, Aug 28-30, 2026) used Pokémon Champions Regulation M-B.

season2027Notes.devicePolicy: Competitors may use any Nintendo Switch / Nintendo Switch 2 family console; mobile devices are not listed (a separate device policy will be set for Worlds 2027).
season2027Notes.ageRule: Brazil: players under 14 on day 1 must use the Junior version (ClassInd 14). Germany: under 12 (USK 12). Early reports said under-14s could not compete in Brazil; the RK9 Recife notice describes the Junior-version path.
season2027Notes.otherChanges: Pokémon UNITE removed from the Championship Series; NAIC moves to Chicago; combined Best Finish Limit for Global/Grand Challenges = 4; regulation sets may last 1-3 months (VGC handbook).

season2027.location: Olinda/Recife (Centro de Convenções de Pernambuco), Brazil

season2027.confidence: high (date/regulation), Masters fee R$315 / Seniors-Juniors R$190, sign-ups via RK9
medium (Serebii lists New Orleans — likely outdated)

season2027Caveat: No 2027 Oceania International Championships (OCIC removed from the circuit in 2024, not restored per search). Event list is compiled from search-result summaries of fan calendars (Victory Road, NimbasaCity Post, Liquipedia, Serebii, Bulbagarden); check https://championships.pokemon.com/en-us/events before relying on exact dates.

battleRules.levelNotes: All Pokémon battle at level 50 (Flat Rules 'Adjust Level = 50').
battleRules.ivs: Fixed at 31 in every stat (no IV system); Showdown validator rejects non-31 IVs for Champions.

statPoints.notes: Stat Points (SP) replace EVs: each SP adds +1 to the stat before the nature multiplier. L50 formula (Showdown): HP = base + SP + 75; other = floor((base + SP + 20) x nature). SP and stat alignment are set/changed any time through the in-game Training feature using VP or Training Tickets; fan guides report +1 SP costs 5 VP (max 330 VP for 66), removing SP is free. Pokémon transferred from HOME keep their 'strength' (SP, alignment, moves, Ability) on first arrival.

natures.name: Stat Alignment
natures.effect: +10% to one stat and -10% to another (neutral alignments such as Serious exist)
natures.how: Training feature; fan guides report 500 VP per change (built-in 'Mint' equivalent).

battleRules.abilities: Exactly one Ability selected per Pokémon; changeable via Training (help_syn [100]-[101]).
battleRules.moves: Up to 4 moves; changeable via Training. PP: base PP capped at 20 and max PP = (basePP/5 + 1) x 4 (e.g. 5->8, 10->12, 15->16, 20->20) per Showdown champions/scripts.ts:3-8, 41-42.
battleRules.megaLimit: Only one Mega Evolution per battle (per player); the Pokémon must hold its species-specific Mega Stone. Megas count as the base species for Species Clause.
megaSources: https://github.com/projectpokemon/champout/ rom-txt/usa/help_syn.json [60]-[62] ('It is only possible to trigger Mega Evolution once per battle.')
battleRules.otherGimmicks: No Dynamax, no Z-Moves; Mega Evolution is the only battle gimmick.
battleRules.format: Double Battles, bring 6 pick 4 (Showdown 'Picked Team Size = Auto' -> 4 for doubles, 'Min Team Size = 6'). Play! Pokémon handbook: teams of 4-6 depending on format; the registered Battle Team must stay unchanged for the whole competition.
battleRules.openTeamSheets: Official Championship events use open team lists: team-list info is shared with the opponent except for certain fields (handbook excerpt cut off; probably Stat Points). Showdown: Bo1 ladder = optional OTS (both must accept), Bo3 = forced OTS; for Champions Showdown reveals species, item, Ability, moves, level and stat alignment (nature) but not SP (commit fa01067, 2026-05-27). In-game Ranked Battles have no team sheets (team preview shows species only).
openTeamSheetsSources: ps-hist fa01067 'Champions: Reveal Nature in Open Team Sheets'

timer.outcomes: Your Time reaching 0 = loss; Total Time running out in Ranked/Casual = draw (no VP/SP awarded) per Automaton.
timer.showdownVGCTimer: Timer Starting = 420 s (7 min Your Time), Grace = 90 s, Add Per Turn = 0, Max Per Turn = 55 s, Max First Turn = 90 s, Timeout Auto Choose, DC Timer Bank (no 20-minute game clock).

battleRules.bo3: Championship-level in-person events (Regionals, Internationals, Worlds) play best-of-three matches (Swiss + single-elimination top cut, all Bo3); online Global Challenges are in-game ladder-style Bo1 battles. Showdown offers '[Gen 9 Champions] VGC 2026 Reg M-C (Bo3)' with forced OTS. Exact round time limit for a Bo3 set was not found.

clauses.detail: No two Pokémon with the same National Pokédex number (formes count as the same, e.g. Rotom-Heat + Rotom-Wash illegal)
No two Pokémon may hold the same item ('Item Clause = 1')
Flat Rules ban them; none are in the M-A/M-B/M-C roster anyway, and no Legendary Pokémon at all are in the roster
clauses.source: https://github.com/smogon/pokemon-showdown/blob/master/data/mods/champions/rulesets.ts:39; computed: 0 legal entries with these tags

clauses.detail: Showdown VGC Reg M-C uses only Flat Rules + VGC Timer + OTS; Showdown OU/UU bans (e.g. Light Clay, King's Rock, Mega Raichu Y) apply to singles only

battleRules.statusMechanics: Champions-specific: paralysis full-para chance 1/8; sleep lasts 2-3 turns; freeze thaws after at most 3 turns (data/mods/champions/conditions.ts).

movesAvailabilityHighLevel.notes: Showdown marks 515 base moves as usable in the Champions mod (vs 685 in Scarlet/Violet base data); legality per Pokémon is set by data/mods/champions/learnsets.ts. Moves present in SV but absent in Champions include Tera Blast, Burning Bulwark, Silk Trap, Surging Strikes, Wicked Blow, Glacial Lance, Astral Barrage, Collision Course, the four 'Storm' moves (Bleakwind/Sandsear/Springtide/Wildbolt) and Teleport — mostly signatures of Pokémon not in Champions. Champions adds back older moves absent from SV: King's Shield, Burn Up, Corrosive Gas, Electrify, Light of Ruin, Meteor Assault, Octolock, Power Shift, Snap Trap, Storm Throw, Trick-or-Treat. M-B vs M-C move flags differ only by PP (Wish, Strength Sap) — M-C learnset changes are separate.

events.notes: 1,096 players; winner Francesco Pio Pero; open team sheets

regulations.legalPokemonRules: Only Pokémon in the Champions roster (186 unique species); no Legendary, Restricted Legendary or Mythical Pokémon exist in the roster; Mega Evolution allowed for listed Megas only (60 Mega formes in Showdown data); Flat Rules (level 50, Species Clause, Item Clause).
regulations.items: 117 held items available (incl. Mega Stones); notably no Life Orb, Expert Belt, Light Clay, Wise Glasses, Muscle Band, weather rocks (added in M-B).
regulations.notes: Transition: Scarlet/Violet Reg I remained legal for some local events until 2026-05-31 (Bulbapedia). Timers: 20 min game / 7 min Your Time / 45 s Move Time / 90 s team preview.

events.event: 2026 Pokémon World Championships, San Francisco (VGC Masters, Seniors, Juniors)
events.notes: Masters winner Takuma Yamazaki (JPN) over Hiroshi Onishi; Seniors Vikram Thiagarajan (UK); Juniors Kazuki Kage (JPN)

regulations.legalPokemonRules: M-A roster + 22 Pokémon and 16 Mega Evolutions (38 Showdown entries) = 208 unique species, 76 Mega formes; still no Legendaries/Mythicals. New abilities Eelevate and Fire Mane introduced.
regulations.items: 148 held items (+31 vs M-A: 16 Mega Stones + Big Root, Damp Rock, Expert Belt, Heat Rock, Icy Rock, Iron Ball, Life Orb, Light Clay, Metronome, Muscle Band, Shed Shell, Smooth Rock, Wide Lens, Wise Glasses, Zoom Lens).
regulations.notes: Official notice was updated on 2026-08-05 to extend M-B by one week to 2026-09-09 (WikiDex/Bulbapedia via search); some pages still show the original 2026-09-02 end.

regulations.legalPokemonRules: M-B roster + 23 species / 35 Showdown entries (incl. 6 Mega formes: Mega Salamence, Mega Golisopod, Mega Baxcalibur and the Z-A 'Z' Megas Absol-Mega-Z, Garchomp-Mega-Z, Lucario-Mega-Z) = 231 unique species, 82 Mega formes; nothing removed; no Legendaries/Mythicals.
regulations.items: 166 held items (+18 vs M-B: 6 Mega Stones + Air Balloon, Binding Band, Eject Button, Electric/Grassy/Misty/Psychic Seed, Leek, Normal Gem, Red Card, Rocky Helmet, Terrain Extender) — matches official '12 held items'.
regulations.notes: Patch 1.2.0 also changed moves/learnsets (e.g. Wish and Strength Sap PP 12 -> 8; some learnset removals) — see patch-notes research. Showdown singles tier moves (e.g. Raichu-Mega-Y/Sneasler to Uber) do NOT affect VGC formats, which only use Flat Rules.
